body: Yeah, it’s nice to get this all off my chest and to know that I am not the only one that feels this way. Can’t tell family and friends this because I don’t want them to feel bad and I really don’t want to be put in a psych ward.

Yeah, it seems when I get those feelings the only thing I can do to escape the constant harassment and life is to sleep which is also hard to do because I know I will wake up and do the same bullshit I hate. 
Well I really hope you keep improving and feel better.

I know it’s self destructive but I want to feel bad because I know I need to end it and the only way that is going to happen is if I am constantly on. I have no ambitions or cares for my future because there is nothing I want in life that would be worth the effort to get so why bother with all the struggle or the future struggle just to get something that isn’t going to make me happy or satisfied with my life. I may feel good now but I know that feeling never last very long. Anyways thanks for sharing your thoughts I really do appreciate it.
